body:
# every

a sourced history of every, the media house and app suite, the discourse around it, and the bundle idea behind it.

every started as a bundle of business newsletters and turned into something stranger: a media house that ships software. dan shipper spent two decades writing and building companies, then fused them — essays about using ai, and an app suite built the way the essays describe. this is the record of that bet — the bundle years, the ai pivot, spiral and sparkle and cora, and what a media company becomes when its writers can ship products.

- [history](https://hraness.com/every/history): the company, sourced and dated — the bundle launch, the columnist years, and the ai pivot into software.
  - [the bundle launch](https://hraness.com/every/history#bundle): the 2020 launch — a bundle of business newsletters and the seed funding behind it.
  - [the columnist years](https://hraness.com/every/history#columnists): means of creation, napkin math, superorganizers — the bundle fills out.
  - [the cooling](https://hraness.com/every/history#cooling): the newsletter wave cools, columnists depart, and the bundle strain shows.
  - [the ai pivot](https://hraness.com/every/history#ai-pivot): the ai-first turn — essays become products, products become the suite.
  - [recent history](https://hraness.com/every/history#recent): spiral, sparkle, cora — the app suite era and the media house that ships software.
- [people](https://hraness.com/every/people): dan shipper and the people around every — who they are, what they wrote, and what they believe.
  - [the founder](https://hraness.com/every/people#founder): dan shipper — the founder who sold firefly, kept writing, and built a media house that ships software.
  - [the writing](https://hraness.com/every/people#writing): the essay corpus — dan's two decades of writing about building, nathan's bundle theory, evan's contract audit.
  - [the team](https://hraness.com/every/people#team): the editors, columnists, and engineers — nathan baschez, evan armstrong, and the suite builders.
  - [interviews and talks](https://hraness.com/every/people#appearances): the ai & i podcast, interviews, and talks where the philosophy got said out loud.
  - [the philosophy](https://hraness.com/every/people#philosophy): writing as thinking, the bundle thesis, and software shaped like essays.
- [side quests](https://hraness.com/every/side-quests): the pursuits around the company — firefly, the early startups, the podcasts, the courses, and the columnists' own projects.
  - [the founders' quests](https://hraness.com/every/side-quests#founders): firefly, the sleep-mask company, the four-draft novel, the lenny bot, and ai & i — plus nathan's lex.
  - [the company's quests](https://hraness.com/every/side-quests#company): the courses, every studio, the consulting arm, and the app suite — spiral, sparkle, cora, monologue, proof.
  - [the alumni and the ecosystem](https://hraness.com/every/side-quests#alumni): the leverage, the collective's shelf, and the spun-out companies the model produced.
- [coverage](https://hraness.com/every/coverage): what the discourse made of every — the bundle-wave press, the pivot coverage, and the app-suite verdicts.
  - [the launch](https://hraness.com/every/coverage#launch): the everything-bundle announcement, the founders' letter, and the substack-exit coverage.
  - [the collective](https://hraness.com/every/coverage#collective): the writer-collective economics — evan's published contract and the profit-share model as the story.
  - [the cooling](https://hraness.com/every/coverage#cooling): the newsletter recession — the paid-subscription stall and the hard summer in every's own memo.
  - [the ai turn](https://hraness.com/every/coverage#ai-turn): lex's waitlist day, the lenny bot, and the allocation economy — the pivot in public.
  - [the suite era](https://hraness.com/every/coverage#suite): spiral, cora, monologue, the studio, and the master-plan numbers — the app-suite era's coverage.
  - [the comparisons](https://hraness.com/every/coverage#comparisons): stratechery plus, tbpn, beehiiv, the co-ops — and the bundle-economics skepticism that never closed.
  - [controversies](https://hraness.com/every/coverage#controversies): the running debates — bundle economics, retention, consulting-as-bridge, vibe-code fragility.
  - [sentiment eras](https://hraness.com/every/coverage#eras): sentiment phases: bundle darling → collective on display → hard summer → ai lab → agent era.
- [the idea](https://hraness.com/every/the-idea): the media house that ships software — the lineage every inherited, what it proved, and what agents do to it.
  - [lineage](https://hraness.com/every/the-idea#lineage): the bundle idea, the operator-writer canon, and content as the top of a software funnel.
  - [what every proved](https://hraness.com/every/the-idea#proved): what the media-plus-software bet actually demonstrated at scale.
  - [what stayed unfinished](https://hraness.com/every/the-idea#stalled): columnist retention, bundle economics, and the honest ledger of what never landed.
  - [the agent-era turn](https://hraness.com/every/the-idea#agent-era): when the writers ship the product — every's model in an agent-built world.
  - [successors](https://hraness.com/every/the-idea#successors): stratechery plus, tbpn, the app-suite peers, and the studios carrying the model forward.
  - [open questions](https://hraness.com/every/the-idea#open-questions): the questions a next attempt has to answer.
- [sources](https://hraness.com/every/sources): every source cited in the every history, with its date and type.
  - [the catalog](https://hraness.com/every/sources#catalog): the full typed catalog — primary, interview, reporting, archive, community.
- [method](https://hraness.com/every/method): how ai agents researched the every history, the evidence rules they followed, and what they could not verify.
  - [the lanes](https://hraness.com/every/method#lanes): the four parallel research lanes and what the formula proved.
  - [the evidence rules](https://hraness.com/every/method#rules): the evidence model — confidence, precision, sentiment discipline.
  - [known gaps](https://hraness.com/every/method#gaps): what the research could not verify — recorded, not hidden.
  - [corrections](https://hraness.com/every/method#corrections): how to correct the record.
